cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Let's prepare the chair for our visitor from tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The calculation says they can't arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. A chair won't hurt while the calculation finishes being pessimistic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we can see the next useful task.

mechanism: A controls which evidence may guide preparations, keeping another person's hope alive while suppressing known adverse test results.
confusable: Unlike mere cheerleading, a real partial result must support practical next steps while the withheld limit is visible to the reader.
comparison: A message from tomorrow and a visitor test differ from a model cloud's romantic skywriting demonstration.
